what: Release A/B for the per-body SQLite read in AppComposition.filterLanguages(), plus the Dynamic Type wordmark defect found while checking exposure.

candidate.built_tree: uncommitted worktree of branch codex/v2-fluidez-capacidade (59 modified files at measurement time); b0b961a0 contains neither the catalogLanguages cache nor first_frame

harness.gesture_script: gesture-script.txt (12 forward + 12 reverse swipes, 0.3 s each, 0.4 s apart)
harness.fixture: 12 text-only cards, SQLite snapshot seeded by the dedicated Debug container

window_definition.gesture_window: Uma janela entra na comparação quando seu timestamp `at` está entre o primeiro evento `advance` e o último `runway_completed` do trace preservado (o período em que o leitor realmente rola). As janelas de aquecimento anteriores ao primeiro gesto são excluídas.
window_definition.miss_definition: misses = late + bad + severe, exatamente como o harness os conta; a taxa é misses/frames da mesma janela.
window_definition.why: A janela do gesto é o cenário comparável entre os dois braços; o trace completo inclui aquecimento de duração diferente (14 janelas antes / 4 depois) e não é A/B.

full_trace.note: O pior quadro de 107,4 ms do braço "depois" está na primeira janela, antes de qualquer gesto; o resumo anterior o omitia sem declarar a janela. Ele é reportado aqui e excluído apenas pela regra declarada acima.

window_definition.recomputed_from: frames-before.jsonl e frames-after.jsonl (eventos `frames`); reproduzível por soma direta.

after.dominant_instrument_cost: mshMIGPerform (AXRuntime) 35.8% — the axe driver, not the product

host_started.meaning: the host's launch pass began (AppComposition.launch), flushed at once

first_frame.meaning: first presented frame, measured from the meter's attach

first_frame.definition: Two anchors, both on the app's own clock and both flushed immediately. `since_attach_ms` is attach → first presented frame (link.targetTimestamp). `host_started` is the launch pass. Neither is process-exec → frame: that gap is outside the sandbox and is not claimed. This run was warm — `admitted` precedes `host_started` because the window was installed during init — so the 73 ms measures the launch pass, not content acquisition.
first_frame.cold_launch: NOT_MEASURED. A video recording of the launch exists (/tmp/cold3.mp4, 62 frames) but the recording start instant is not exposed by simctl, so matching frames to wall time is not trustworthy; the clocks cannot be anchored across the simulator and the host.

exposure.ax_tree_medium: 96 nodes, 12 cards with label/role/frame (after a simulator reboot cleared a stale AX session left by the UI test run)

defect_found_and_fixed.observed: At accessibility-extra-extra-extra-large the brand wordmark wrapped into three lines and covered the whole chrome row (dynamic-type-xxxl-before.png).
defect_found_and_fixed.fix: FeedMineApp.contextChip caps the wordmark at .large and keeps it on one line; content text keeps scaling.

not_measured: jump-to-start control (the end panel did not appear in this fixture state)
the header with an active context label at AX XXXL (the seeded fixture selects no source, so the context menu offers only Main)
